answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the karst queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The zenith index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 172 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the plume. A 217 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
